profile.headline: Software Engineer at S&S Activewear
profile.summary: I am a Software Developer for S&S Activewear. I'm interested in software and web development. I also do freelance web development from time to time.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained the front-end of the South American Dealer Sites for General Motors to promote brand continuity across markets. Handled communication with business partners to align development goals with business expectations. Offered my expertise to both the development and business teams to avoid development or communication hurdles after project start.

Led an initiative to transition all South American dealers from a proprietary, GM hosted, server and platform to the cloud-based Adobe Experience Manager environment to cut down on operational costs and increase usability. Developed Java scripts to automate migration of said dealer sites to reduce friction between teams. Added functionality to the AEM environment to fit the needs of South American business partners.

Led the implementation of the Barclays Rewards and Onstar navigation to facilitate business partnerships, increase usability, and align with modern design standards. Updated all major General Motors brand sites to be compatible with Right to Left styling in preparation for expansion into the Middle East market. Interfaced with external business partners to create future-proof solutions for important infrastructure.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Created blog posts to help new users get acquainted with new technologies and worked on developing new features that create a more fluid experience for users.

positions.title: Social Director
positions.description: Board Member for the Penn State Esports Club. Organizer of the Looking for Group Program, a program implemented and designed to integrate new club members to the world of esports.
